items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Because these other fellows, like Pete Burkard, they was reading musicians.

ctx.x: But otherwise it would sound, it would take over so big if they was here, you know. Because these other fellows, like Pete Burkard, they was reading musicians. You know, they didn't get from here. They're just like a preacher. A preacher at that time was a better preacher than the preachers now for their education. You see what I mean? The preachers then would preach and understand what they're preaching about and they'd just get the words and they wouldn't know how to read it in a book. Now them fellows didn't…
Did you hear much music in the churches? Did you belong to a church in those days? Did you ever go to the churches? Did you hear any of the singing there? What kind of music they had there?
